normalized.result: Yes, that all matches what I expect. "Saved just now" turning into an actual date over time makes sense. And I agree editing a bookmark shouldn't bump it to the top — newest-first should mean when I first saved it, so my library doesn't keep reshuffling just because I tidied something up. Most importantly, my bookmarks, tags, and read-later choices should stick around after I close the browser and be right there when I come back, even from another computer — that "get to them wherever I am" part was one of my main reasons for wanting a web app. This is right.
